other_conditions: Girl must be born on or after April 1, 2014
Benefit limited to two daughters per family; a third daughter is not eligible (except special inclusion for HIV‑affected couples born after April 1, 2016)
If the family has two sons, a third daughter is not eligible for the benefit
For the second girl child, at least one parent must have adopted a permanent family planning method before applying
All girls born as twins or multiple births in the first or second delivery are eligible
A third girl born after benefit has been given to twin girls in the first delivery is not eligible
Legally adopted girls are eligible if they meet all other criteria
Girl must not marry before reaching 18 years of age
Girl must have completed 12th standard education
Application must be submitted within 1 year of the girl’s birth (extendable up to 2 years, with special provisions for orphaned or deceased parents)
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 at age 18 and a LIC investment of ₹25,000 over 5 years.
documents_required: Affidavit of being unmarried until 18 years of age (verified by Child Development Project Officer or authorised officer)
Proof of inclusion in the current poverty‑line survey list of the Rural Development Department
